name: Tahmar Enterprises Limited
about: Tahmar Enterprises Limited engages in the ethanol and distillery operations business in India. Its products include molasses, spirits, alcohol, and power. The company manufactures grain-based specialty products, such as grain extra neutral alcohol, dried distillers grain solids, distillers wet grains soluble, Indian made foreign liquors, premium country liquor, coal ash, and alcohol sanitizer. The company was formerly known as Sarda Papers Limited and changed its name Tahmar Enterprises Limited in December 2022. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Panaji, India.
